name: CKEditor Break Tag
description: To insert breaktag between text in ckeditor.
project_description:
Minimal module to insert a break tag into the content by using the provided button or using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Enter.

 Back to top 

 Uses 
 During content creation the author may want to break a paragraph into multiple lines irrespective of automatic line breaks, In such cases author can use this.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install the module then follow the instructions for installing the CKEditor plugins below.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Go to the 'Text formats and editors' configuration page: /admin/config/content/formats , and for each text format/editor combo where you want to use BreakTag, drag and drop the 'BreakTag' icon to the admin toolbar.

 Back to top
